note: Accepted boundary violations as of 2026-09-07, the day before the three extractions land. Every row is a real coupling that the guard would otherwise fail on; each names the extraction expected to remove it. Rules: nothing may be added here to make a new violation pass without a reviewed reason; a row whose violation no longer exists is a hard failure in --mode enforce, so a fix must delete its row in the same commit. Regenerate the mechanical parts with `--write-baseline`, which preserves removed_by and why and leaves new rows as "unassigned" (also a hard failure), then attribute them by hand.

accepted.why: The bootstrap locates the dashboard with git worktree add against the in-repo vaws-top branch and then validates .agents/skills/vaws-top/SKILL.md inside that worktree. After extraction there is no such branch, so it must clone or locate the vaws-top repository instead.
